The '''Barnaba House Guard''' was the [[House Guard]] that served [[House Barnaba]]. The Guard's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisted of five [[Tapani-class assault frigate|''Tapani''-class assault frigates]] and a number of [[Patrol ship/Legends|system patrol craft]]. [[High Lord|high Lady]] [[Varin Arabella]] served in the Barnaba House Guard before being appointed leader of House Barnaba.<ref name="LE" />
